hero.headline: Questions clinics ask before they start.

faqs.question: Can you keep our ads from getting rejected?
faqs.answer: We structure pages, creative, and copy around prescription-advertising policy from the start — that is the single biggest reason clinic campaigns stall. We cannot guarantee a platform decision, but compliance is designed in rather than patched later.

faqs.question: Who approves medical claims?
faqs.answer: You do. Every treatment detail, eligibility statement, and patient-facing clinical claim goes to your licensed providers for review before it publishes. We write for review, not around it.

faqs.question: How long until we see results?
faqs.answer: Conversion work (landing pages, intake flows, follow-up) tends to show movement in the first 30–60 days. Visibility and education compound over 3–6 months. We report on both timelines so you can tell which is which.

faqs.question: Do we have to buy the whole system?
faqs.answer: No. Most clinics start with one stage — usually Conversion — and add Visibility, Follow-Up, or Optimization as capacity and demand grow. The stages are built to connect later.

faqs.question: Will you work with our existing website or agency?
faqs.answer: Yes. We often build alongside an existing site and hand off documentation. If you already have an agency running paid media, we can own conversion and follow-up and feed them better inputs.

faqs.question: What do you need from us to start?
faqs.answer: Access to your site, ad accounts, and analytics; one clinical reviewer for content approval; and roughly an hour a month from someone who can answer program questions. We handle the rest.

faqs.question: What happens on the growth gap call?
faqs.answer: Thirty minutes. We look at your visibility, your consult path, and your follow-up, then send a written summary of the gaps we found and what we would fix first — whether or not you hire us.
